text:
No one can save you but
yourself.

you will see yourself again and again
in situations
almost impossible.

they will try again and again
through subterfuge, deception or
by force
to make you give up, surrender and/or die slowly
inside.

No one can save you but
yourself
and it will be very easy to faint,
very easy,
but do not faint, no, no
just look at them.

listen to them.

Do you want to be like that?

A faceless, mindless
heartless being?

Do you want to experience
death before death?

No one can save you but
yourself
and you deserve to save yourself.

It is not an easy war to win
but if anything is worth winning,
it is this.

Think about it.

Think about saving yourself.
your spiritual part.
the part of your guts.
your magical and drunken part.
save it.

Do not join the spiritually dead.

Stay
in good humor and style
and in the end,
if necessary,
bet your life in the thick of the fight,
to hell with the odds, to hell with
the price.

No one can save you but
yourself.

Do it! Save yourself!

then you will know exactly
what I am talking about.

translation.title: No One Can Save You but...
translation.editorial_note:
Translated from the supplied Spanish version attributed to Charles Bukowski. Repeated imperatives, direct address, and stanza breaks are preserved.

Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
